title: How It Works
description: Sessions last 60-75 minutes. You control your own experience, cycling between heat and cold at your own pace.

steps.title: Book a Session
steps.description: Reserve your spot online. Choose your location and time. Limited spots per session—book like a workout class.

steps.title: Heat Up 🔥
steps.description: Take a seat in our saunas. Step out anytime, but take a break after 15-20 consecutive minutes.

steps.title: Cool Down ❄️
steps.description: Dip into the cold water (or enjoy the cool air). Any amount of cold exposure complements sauna use.

steps.title: Repeat 🔄
steps.description: Cycle between hot and cold at your own pace. Start and end on hot or cold—you're the boss.

good_to_know: Bring a towel (required to sit on in the sauna)
Leave valuables at home—shelves available for essentials
Rinse off sandy feet before entering
Close the door quickly to keep the heat in
Let others know before pouring water on rocks
Respect your fellow saunamates—Bywater is a shared space
